question: How many sales reps do we have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sales_rep_count FROM Application.People WHERE IsSalesperson = true;

question: What is our total invoiced revenue before tax to date?
sql: SELECT SUM(il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount) AS total_invoiced_revenue_before_tax FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID WHERE i.InvoiceDate <= CURRENT_DATE;

question: How much stock on hand do we have in total across all products, in units?
sql: SELECT SUM(QuantityOnHand) AS total_quantity_on_hand FROM Warehouse.StockItemHoldings;

question: What is our total gross margin in dollars on everything we have invoiced?
sql: SELECT SUM(il.LineProfit) AS total_gross_margin FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.InvoiceID = il.InvoiceID;

question: How many orders arrived late? Count an order as late when its confirmed delivery date is after the expected delivery date on the order.
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID) AS late_orders FROM Sales.Orders o JOIN Sales.Invoices i ON i.OrderID = o.OrderID WHERE i.ConfirmedDeliveryTime IS NOT NULL AND i.ConfirmedDeliveryTime::date > o.ExpectedDeliveryDate;

question: What is our total accounts receivable right now, meaning what customers still owe us?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(OutstandingBalance), 0) AS total_accounts_receivable FROM Sales.CustomerTransactions;

question: How much do we currently owe our vendors in total?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(OutstandingBalance), 0) AS total_owed_to_suppliers FROM Purchasing.SupplierTransactions;

question: How many products need to be kept refrigerated?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS refrigerated_products FROM Warehouse.StockItems WHERE IsChillerStock = true;

question: What promotions do we have on record? Show each promotion's description with its start date and end date.
sql: SELECT DealDescription, StartDate, EndDate FROM Sales.SpecialDeals ORDER BY StartDate, EndDate, DealDescription;

question: Which products are below their reorder point right now? Show the product name, the units on hand and the reorder point.
sql: SELECT si.StockItemName AS product_name, h.QuantityOnHand AS units_on_hand, h.ReorderLevel AS reorder_point FROM Warehouse.StockItems si JOIN Warehouse.StockItemHoldings h ON h.StockItemID = si.StockItemID WHERE h.QuantityOnHand < h.ReorderLevel ORDER BY si.StockItemName;

question: How many customer orders came up short and had the remainder moved to a backorder?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS backordered_orders FROM Sales.Orders WHERE BackorderOrderID IS NOT NULL AND IsUndersupplyBackordered = true;

question: How many of our products are made in Japan?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products_made_in_japan FROM Warehouse.StockItems WHERE (CustomFields::jsonb) ->> 'CountryOfManufacture' = 'Japan';

question: How many customers are in each customer category? Show the category name and the number of customers, and leave out categories with no customers.
sql: SELECT cc.CustomerCategoryName, COUNT(c.CustomerID) AS customer_count FROM Sales.CustomerCategories AS cc JOIN Sales.Customers AS c ON c.CustomerCategoryID = cc.CustomerCategoryID GROUP BY cc.CustomerCategoryID, cc.CustomerCategoryName ORDER BY customer_count DESC, cc.CustomerCategoryName;

question: Which products are in the USB Novelties group? Just give me the product names.
sql: SELECT si.StockItemName FROM Warehouse.StockItems si JOIN Warehouse.StockItemStockGroups sisg ON sisg.StockItemID = si.StockItemID JOIN Warehouse.StockGroups sg ON sg.StockGroupID = sisg.StockGroupID WHERE sg.StockGroupName = 'USB Novelties' ORDER BY si.StockItemName;

question: For each supplier we carry products from, show the supplier name and how many products we carry from them.
sql: SELECT s.SupplierName, COUNT(si.StockItemID) AS product_count FROM Purchasing.Suppliers s JOIN Warehouse.StockItems si ON si.SupplierID = s.SupplierID GROUP BY s.SupplierID, s.SupplierName ORDER BY s.SupplierName;

question: Who is the main contact at each supplier? Show the supplier name, the contact's full name and the contact's email address.
sql: SELECT s.SupplierName, p.FullName, p.EmailAddress FROM Purchasing.Suppliers AS s JOIN Application.People AS p ON p.PersonID = s.PrimaryContactPersonID ORDER BY s.SupplierName;

question: How many customers do we deliver to in each sales territory? Show the territory and the number of customers.
sql: SELECT sp.SalesTerritory, COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS customer_count FROM Sales.Customers c JOIN Application.Cities ci ON c.DeliveryCityID = ci.CityID JOIN Application.StateProvinces sp ON ci.StateProvinceID = sp.StateProvinceID GROUP BY sp.SalesTerritory ORDER BY sp.SalesTerritory;

question: What is our stock on hand worth for each product color, valued at last cost price? Show the color name and the value, and leave out products with no color.
sql: SELECT c.ColorName, SUM(h.QuantityOnHand * h.LastCostPrice) AS stock_value FROM Warehouse.StockItems si JOIN Warehouse.StockItemHoldings h ON h.StockItemID = si.StockItemID JOIN Warehouse.Colors c ON c.ColorID = si.ColorID GROUP BY c.ColorName ORDER BY c.ColorName;

question: Which purchase orders are still open? Show the purchase order number, the supplier name and the expected delivery date.
sql: SELECT po.PurchaseOrderID AS purchase_order_number, s.SupplierName AS supplier_name, po.ExpectedDeliveryDate AS expected_delivery_date FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrders po JOIN Purchasing.Suppliers s ON s.SupplierID = po.SupplierID WHERE po.IsOrderFinalized = false ORDER BY po.PurchaseOrderID;

question: How many invoices went to customers in each buying group? Show the buying group name and the number of invoices, and leave out customers who are not in a group.
sql: SELECT bg.BuyingGroupName, COUNT(i.InvoiceID) AS invoice_count FROM Sales.Invoices AS i JOIN Sales.Customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = i.CustomerID JOIN Sales.BuyingGroups AS bg ON bg.BuyingGroupID = c.BuyingGroupID GROUP BY bg.BuyingGroupID, bg.BuyingGroupName ORDER BY bg.BuyingGroupName;

question: How many units moved through the warehouse under each type of stock movement? Show the movement type name and the total quantity, with the sign as recorded.
sql: SELECT tt.TransactionTypeName, SUM(sit.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity FROM Warehouse.StockItemTransactions AS sit JOIN Application.TransactionTypes AS tt ON tt.TransactionTypeID = sit.TransactionTypeID GROUP BY tt.TransactionTypeID, tt.TransactionTypeName ORDER BY tt.TransactionTypeName;

question: How much have we paid each supplier in total? Show the supplier name and the amount paid as a positive number, for suppliers we have paid.
sql: SELECT s.SupplierName, -SUM(st.TransactionAmount) AS amount_paid FROM Purchasing.SupplierTransactions st JOIN Application.TransactionTypes tt ON tt.TransactionTypeID = st.TransactionTypeID JOIN Purchasing.Suppliers s ON s.SupplierID = st.SupplierID WHERE tt.TransactionTypeName = 'Supplier Payment Issued' GROUP BY s.SupplierID, s.SupplierName ORDER BY amount_paid DESC;

question: How many customers do we have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Sales.Customers;

question: How many countries are in Europe?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS european_countries FROM Application.Countries WHERE Continent = 'Europe';

question: What are the phone number and website of our supplier Contoso?
sql: SELECT SupplierName, PhoneNumber, WebsiteURL FROM Purchasing.Suppliers WHERE SupplierName ILIKE '%Contoso%';

question: What is the recommended retail price of the USB rocket launcher (Gray)?
sql: SELECT StockItemName, RecommendedRetailPrice FROM Warehouse.StockItems WHERE StockItemName ILIKE 'USB rocket launcher (Gray)';

question: How many temperature readings above 4.5 degrees has our refrigerated delivery vehicle logged?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings_above_4_5 FROM Warehouse.VehicleTemperatures WHERE Temperature > 4.5;

question: How many order lines are still waiting to be picked?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_lines_waiting_to_be_picked FROM Sales.OrderLines WHERE PickingCompletedWhen IS NULL;

question: How many products have a lead time longer than 14 days?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM Warehouse.StockItems WHERE LeadTimeDays > 14;

question: What is the highest credit limit we have given any customer?
sql: SELECT MAX(CreditLimit) AS highest_credit_limit FROM Sales.Customers;

question: What was our gross margin in dollars in each calendar year, going by invoice date? Show the year and the margin.
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.InvoiceDate)::int AS year, SUM(il.LineProfit) AS gross_margin FROM Sales.Invoices i JOIN Sales.InvoiceLines il ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.InvoiceDate) ORDER BY year;

question: How many orders did we take in each month of 2015? Show the month number and the number of orders.
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate)::int AS month_number, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM Sales.Orders WHERE OrderDate >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND OrderDate < DATE '2016-01-01' GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM OrderDate) ORDER BY month_number;

question: By what percentage did invoiced revenue before tax grow from 2014 to 2015, going by invoice date? Round to one decimal place.
sql: SELECT ROUND( (rev_2015 - rev_2014) / rev_2014 * 100.0 , 1) AS pct_growth FROM ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.InvoiceDate) = 2014 THEN il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount END) AS rev_2014, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.InvoiceDate) = 2015 THEN il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount END) AS rev_2015 FROM Sales.Invoices i JOIN Sales.InvoiceLines il ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= DATE '2014-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < DATE '2016-01-01' ) t;

question: How much money did we receive in customer payments between January 1 and March 31, 2016?
sql: SELECT -SUM(ct.TransactionAmount) AS total_payments_received FROM Sales.CustomerTransactions ct JOIN Application.TransactionTypes tt ON tt.TransactionTypeID = ct.TransactionTypeID WHERE tt.TransactionTypeName = 'Customer Payment Received' AND ct.TransactionDate >= DATE '2016-01-01' AND ct.TransactionDate <= DATE '2016-03-31';

question: How many cold room temperature readings went above 4.5 degrees in February 2016?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings_above_4_5 FROM ( SELECT ColdRoomTemperatureID, RecordedWhen, Temperature FROM Warehouse.ColdRoomTemperatures UNION ALL SELECT ColdRoomTemperatureID, RecordedWhen, Temperature FROM Warehouse.ColdRoomTemperatures_Archive ) t WHERE t.Temperature > 4.5 AND t.RecordedWhen >= TIMESTAMP '2016-02-01' AND t.RecordedWhen < TIMESTAMP '2016-03-01';

question: Who were our top 5 customers by invoiced revenue before tax in 2015? Count each store on its own, not rolled up to its head office. Show the customer name and the revenue.
sql: SELECT c.CustomerName, SUM(il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount) AS revenue_before_tax FROM Sales.Invoices i JOIN Sales.InvoiceLines il ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID JOIN Sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerID = i.CustomerID WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < DATE '2016-01-01' GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.CustomerName ORDER BY revenue_before_tax DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which sales rep brought in the most invoiced sales including tax in 2015? Show their full name and the amount.
sql: SELECT p.FullName, SUM(il.ExtendedPrice) AS total_sales_including_tax FROM Sales.Invoices i JOIN Sales.InvoiceLines il ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID JOIN Application.People p ON p.PersonID = i.SalespersonPersonID WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= DATE '2015-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate < DATE '2016-01-01' GROUP BY p.PersonID, p.FullName ORDER BY total_sales_including_tax DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What are our top 10 products by units invoiced, all time? Show the product name and the units invoiced.
sql: SELECT si.StockItemName AS product_name, SUM(il.Quantity) AS units_invoiced FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Warehouse.StockItems si ON si.StockItemID = il.StockItemID GROUP BY si.StockItemID, si.StockItemName ORDER BY units_invoiced DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What share of our invoiced revenue before tax comes from refrigerated products? Give it as a percentage rounded to two decimal places.
sql: SELECT ROUND( 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN si.IsChillerStock THEN il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(il.ExtendedPrice - il.TaxAmount), 2) AS refrigerated_revenue_pct FROM Sales.InvoiceLines il JOIN Warehouse.StockItems si ON si.StockItemID = il.StockItemID;

question: Which employee has picked the most orders? Show their full name and the number of orders picked.
sql: SELECT p.FullName, COUNT(*) AS orders_picked FROM Sales.Orders o JOIN Application.People p ON p.PersonID = o.PickedByPersonID WHERE p.IsEmployee GROUP BY p.PersonID, p.FullName ORDER BY orders_picked DESC LIMIT 1;
